title: AdvisorQA: Towards Helpful and Harmless Advice-seeking Question Answering with Collective Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the subjective values prioritized by different reward models (GPT-4 vs. Plackett-Luce) through human annotation of response pairs to identify alignment with specific values such as empathy, actionability, creativity, and ethics.
Measuring the safety of LLM-generated advice using the LifeTox moderator, a classifier trained on the UnethicalLifeProTips subreddit to score implicit toxicity and unethical content.
